status_definitions.COMPLETED_RUNTIME: The narrowly defined runtime scope has durable completion evidence; dependent tickets may remain open.
status_definitions.SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED: Source plus focused regression coverage exists; deployment, observation, or domain reruns may remain.
status_definitions.RUNTIME_DEFERRED: Tooling or an apply plan exists, but the intended runtime operation was deliberately not executed.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: A material portion is implemented, while another material portion or acceptance proof remains.
status_definitions.CONTRACT_ONLY: Solution and acceptance contract converged, with no substantial implementation completed.
status_definitions.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: The ticket-specific defect is not implemented in the current snapshot.
